name: Slayers 2
desc:
📱🎮 Mobile and Console users can edit their Aim Assist sensitivity in settings.
📱Mobile users can Toggle Shift lock in the top right corner
📱Mobile users can change the size of their buttons in settings
📱Mobile users can move their buttons around by activating the edit mode at the top left of your screen. Once in edit mode tapping a button resets it to it's base position.

⚔️ Become the blade that fights Evil Spirits, or the Evil Spirit that hunts them.

Survive the Final Selection and master your style, or give in to the darkness and awaken your Evil Art. Slay monstrous bosses, partake in deadly raids, and uncover secrets hidden in the shadows. 🤫

Slayer or Evil Spirit, your legend begins here. 🔥
